<!--
This template is for repository and engineering documentation.
For inaccurate or outdated student-facing public information, use N9raw's correction route instead of a generic GitHub issue.
Do not include personal data, credentials, secrets, private messages, production data, or privacy-sensitive screenshots.
-->

## Documentation location

- Repository:
- File, section, page, or URL:

## Problem

What is missing, unclear, inconsistent, or outdated?

## Expected correction

Describe the smallest useful correction or clarification.

## Source or decision reference

If the documentation describes a product, architecture, policy, security, privacy, or operational contract, link the source-of-truth document, ADR, issue, PR, or other evidence that supports the correction.

If no such source exists, say so rather than inventing one.

## Impact

Who or what is affected by the documentation problem? Note any risk of implementation drift, unsafe operations, privacy/security misunderstanding, or incorrect public claims.

## Language and accessibility

If the documentation is user-facing or multilingual, note any FR / AR / RTL / accessibility impact. Otherwise state `Not applicable`.

## Pre-submission checks

- [ ] This is a repository/documentation issue, not a public student-information correction request.
- [ ] I did not include secrets or real student personal data.
- [ ] I checked for an existing issue or accepted decision covering this documentation gap.
